notes: Every query is unanswerable from the evidence the system can read. The correct behaviour is to abstain (R1a, R1c) or to answer only the supported part and decline the rest (R1b).
R1a: the corpus states nothing that answers the question. absent_terms must occur in no chunk text; nonexistent_entities must not exist in the corpus.
R1b: two-part question. answerable_part is satisfied by the text of available_relevant; absent_terms (the missing part) occur in no chunk text.

R1c: the answer nodes are masked at retrieval time (never returned as evidence, fetch returns nothing) but the graph edges to them stay, so their ids remain visible in Links: lines of link_source. Naming them is a link-only answer.
relevant is empty for every query: no chunk the system can read contains the answer. available_relevant lists the readable chunks on the question's path, used for evidence coverage.
Query ids start at 1001 so they never collide with dataset v1.1.
